text:
maya: Kicking off the staged failover bench now. goal: compare replay vs synth with interleaved region drain, and measure p50/p99 delta when fallback model gets routed.

harry: 👍 can you confirm which kernel profiles we're forcing? last time kernel-switching added jitter.

maya: Forcing: 
```
KERNEL_HINT=auto
FORCE_KERNELS="fp16_int8_v2,v1"
BATCHING_PROFILE=dynamic-lifo
KV_CACHE=primed
```
we'll also toggle `KV_CACHE=flush` in the 2nd pass.

jo: Quick Q — are we preserving the same prompt set for apples-to-apples? replay harness should use the production trace, synth should use sampled seq-len distribution.

maya: Yes. replay = 2026-02-prod-trace-1, synth = sampled-dist-1 with same seq length histogram. seeds pinned.

liam: benchbot will post the run summary when finished. I'll watch the region-drain window.

benchbot: run_id=run-1945678901
mode=staged-failover
phases=[baseline, drain, fallback, recovery]
start=1945678901
status=running

harry: Reminder: measure two things separately — kernel-selection overhead (time spent in kernel pick + warmup) and batching impact (in-flight latency increase due to aggregation).

maya: logged per-request annotations: `kernel_pick_ms`, `batch_wait_ms`, `kv_hit` (true/false).

jo: If kv_hit=false during fallback we should expect extra 40-120ms for kv refill on long chats. flag that in csv.

benchbot: phase=baseline complete (3m) p50=24ms p95=78ms p99=155ms tps=320

liam: baseline numbers look clean. kernel_switch_rate=0.6% (expected). batching_mean=12ms.

benchbot: phase=drain start -> draining us-west1 out of rotation (traffic reroute to us-east1 + eu-central)

harry: during drain we expect routing penalty due to cross-region RTT. acceptable p99 bump is <30ms for PLG tier.

maya: note: fallback policy is: if us-west1 unavailable AND target model not available -> route to fallback-model `opt-quant-8b` in nearest region.

benchbot: phase=drain complete p50=36ms p95=120ms p99=260ms tps=295 (7.8% drop)

jo: p99 jumped a lot. need to parse kernel_pick_ms distribution.

maya: parsed row sample: 
```
request_id,kv_hit,kernel_pick_ms,batch_wait_ms,total_ms
r1,false,8,18,380
r2,true,2,10,28
r3,false,12,25,410
```
most high-total_ms had kv_hit=false and were served by fallback model.

harry: so two orthogonal sources of latency: routing delta across regions (~40-80ms) + fallback model kernel differences (extra 200-300ms for smaller quantized kernels under cold paths).

liam: Important: batching behavior changed under lower tps -> batch sizes shrank which actually reduced batch_wait_ms but increased kernel inefficiency. we'll need to capture throughput-normalized latency.

benchbot: phase=fallback active -> 17% of requests routed to fallback-model due to capacity filter
summary: p50=46ms p95=230ms p99=510ms tps=265

jo: Those p99s are unacceptable. Can we test a config where fallback-model is warmed (kv prefill) and kernel pinned to the same optimized path?

maya: yes — follow-up pass will prefill KV for fallback and set `PIN_KERNEL=fp16_int8_v2` for fallback nodes. will also run synth traffic at same RPS for apples-to-apples.

harry: Also run `--constant-batch-window=8ms` to simulate production batching; dynamic lifo can hide latency spikes.

benchbot: run_id=run-1945678901-pass2 start=1945679032 status=running

benchbot: pass2 baseline p50=25ms p95=80ms p99=160ms tps=318
benchbot: pass2 drain p50=30ms p95=95ms p99=170ms tps=308
benchbot: pass2 fallback (warmed+pin) p50=28ms p95=98ms p99=190ms tps=300

liam: huge improvement on p99 when warm+pin. that suggests kernel cold path + kv fill were main culprits, not cross-region only.

jo: synth vs replay comparison?

maya: synth (matched histogram) fallback p99=210ms, replay p99=190ms — interestingly synth had higher p95 tails because it created larger microbursts that forced batch assembly differences.

harry: action items: 
- add pre-warm steps for fallback model in drain plan
- add `PIN_KERNEL` option to routing policy for critical paths
- instrument `kv_fill_ms` separate from `kv_get_ms` in traces
- update canary playbook to include synthetic interleaved drain test

liam: i'll file a short RFC and an infra ticket to add pre-warm hook to the routing controller.

maya: created infra ticket INF-1129 with run artifacts and parsed csv. attaching run summary link: https://ci.redwood.run/bench/run-1945678901/artifacts

harry: thanks. let's re-run next week against a full multi-region mesh with heavier seq-lens.

sre-oncall: noted — will schedule maintenance window for a larger sweep. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks team, closing thread after we add the `PIN_KERNEL` toggle to feature flags.

liam: :thumbsup:
